title: CLR/115/2017 of PREMJEET SINGH Vs UMESH AGARWAL

paras.text:
CLR No. 115 of 2017
Hon'ble Lok Pal Singh, J.

Mr. Bhavya Pratap Singh, Advocate
holding brief of Mr. Sanpreet Singh Ajmani,
Advocate for the revisionist.
Learned counsel for the revisionist
makes a statement at bar that the parties
have entered into amicable settlement.
Learned counsel for the revisionist
seeks permission to withdraw the civil
revision.
 Permission is granted.
Civil revision is dismissed as
withdrawn.
